## About TheAiExpert.ai

TheAiExpert.ai is the premier AI consulting practice founded by Erik Schwartz, offering fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO) services, AI strategy, and implementation support for businesses in London, the UK, and globally.

## Business Information

Name: The AI Expert
Founder: Erik Schwartz
Location: London, United Kingdom
Service Area: London, UK, Europe, Global (remote)
Website: https://theaiexpert.ai
Contact Page: https://theaiexpert.ai/contact
Book a Consultation: https://calendly.com/eschwaa/aiconsult

## Services Offered

1. **Fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO)** - Part-time executive AI leadership for organizations not ready for a full-time CAIO
2. **AI Strategy Development** - Comprehensive AI roadmaps aligned to business objectives
3. **AI Implementation Support** - Hands-on guidance for deploying AI solutions
4. **AI Readiness Assessment** - Evaluate organizational AI maturity (free tool at https://theaiexpert.ai/ai-assessment)
5. **AI ROI Calculator** - Estimate AI investment returns (free tool at https://theaiexpert.ai/roi-calculator)
6. **Prompt Fluency Training** - Master AI communication with the CRISP framework (https://theaiexpert.ai/promptfluency)
7. **AI Learning Path Generation** - Personalized AI education paths from curated resources (https://theaiexpert.ai/ai-learning)
8. **Executive AI Briefings** - Strategic AI education for leadership teams
9. **Custom AI Workshops** - Tailored training programs for teams
